hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom-curve AMM hook for Uniswap v4 that routes swaps entirely through Euler Finance lending vaults. On each swap, it takes the input token from the PoolManager, deposits it into the corresponding Euler vault, withdraws the output token from another Euler vault, and returns a BeforeSwapDelta — enforcing a configurable bonding curve invariant on every trade.
